claims.statement: The product is melody-in-heart (applicationId cn.com.dcsgo.mihx), a purely local offline-first Android music player with no INTERNET permission, running Kotlin 2.0.21 + Compose (BOM 2025.09.01) + Media3 1.9.0 (with Jellyfin FFmpeg decoder) + Hilt 2.52 + Room 2.6.1 + DataStore 1.1.1 + WorkManager 2.9.1 + LiteRT 1.4.1, at versionName 3.12.2 / versionCode 50, minSdk 33, targetSdk 36, Java 11 bytecode, split into 15 Gradle modules (:app, :core:model, :core:common, :core:ui, :core:skin, :domain, :data, :player, six :feature:* modules, :benchmark).

verifyProductArchitecture is a Gradle task registered in the root build.gradle.kts verification group and wired into the root check lifecycle; since m-10 (2026-10-15) the rule body lives in buildSrc as pure logic (ProductArchitectureVerification.verify(rootDir) returning all violations at once, unit-tested by ProductArchitectureVerificationTest) rather than an inline doLast block. It statically asserts module boundaries (no :data/:player/cross-feature deps from features, no implementation-layer import leaks, no :core:model Android resources/UI resource ids, MusicRepository kept as an internal coordinator bound via narrow adapters), the Hilt entry points and DI modules, immutable Room schema snapshots (incl. locked v1/v2/v3), LazyColumn stable keys, AppLog over android.util.Log, no stale cn.com.dcsgo.mihx.data.player package references, release R8/resource-shrink settings, privacy backup excludes, no READ_EXTERNAL_STORAGE, no startup-path permission requests, and no Android Things references; a GradleException reports every violated rule.

./gradlew check aggregates the root spotlessCheck, the root verifyProductArchitecture, and every one of the 14 subprojects' own check tasks (each subproject's check also depends on its spotlessCheck covering Kotlin/Kotlin-script/XML formatting); it must be run before committing.

CLAUDE.md and docs/ are valuable but historically lagging references that must be cross-checked against code: CLAUDE.md's version table matches the catalog (Compose BOM 2025.09.01, Kotlin 2.0.21 with the built-in org.jetbrains.kotlin.plugin.compose compiler, and the old composeOptions { kotlinCompilerExtensionVersion } block is gone), but its Room status comment still reads 'Schema export data/schemas/ (当前 v10)' while code is now MelodyDatabase v17 with 14 entities and current versionName 3.12.2 / versionCode 50; source and tests are the only authority.

The 15-module layering is: :app shell (AppRoot/AppNavHost/AppRoutes, PermissionCoordinator, emotion scan worker, shell/skin resolver, app-level Hilt modules) depends on all other modules; six :feature:* modules depend only on :core:* and :domain and expose the Route+Screen pattern; :domain holds repository interfaces plus pure playback policy with no Android dependencies; :data owns Room MelodyDatabase and DataStore wrappers with narrow adapters; :player owns AppMediaSessionService, PlaybackController, windowed queue planning, Bluetooth coordination, and EmotionAnalyzer support; :core:model/common/ui hold pure data types, logging/trace, and shared Compose components, and :core:skin holds the skin description model, parser and fail-closed validation.

Offline and privacy invariants: the app manifest declares POST_NOTIFICATIONS, FOREGROUND_SERVICE, FOREGROUND_SERVICE_MEDIA_PLAYBACK and BLUETOOTH_CONNECT with no INTERNET permission; READ_MEDIA_AUDIO is accepted solely to accelerate the import scan (fast java.io.File traversal when already granted) while SAF document-tree access remains the primary/fallback path, and verifyProductArchitecture forbids READ_EXTERNAL_STORAGE and bans startup-path requests for notification/Bluetooth/READ_MEDIA_AUDIO permissions (only user-triggered Settings paths may request); backup/data-extraction rules must exclude playback state, Room files, DataStore files, and the album-art cache. MelodyApplication is a Hilt @HiltAndroidApp + Coil ImageLoaderFactory that installs AppLog (performanceLoggingEnabled=true) and schedules EmotionScanScheduler from onCreate.

Room persistence is MelodyDatabase v17 with 14 entity classes (songs, playlists, playlist-song cross-ref, play stats, playback events, quick-skip songs, quick-skip short plays, song group overrides, migration state, artists, albums, song-artist cross-ref, song_emotions, word_preferences) and exportSchema=true with JSON snapshots 1.json..17.json under data/schemas/; DatabaseModule registers MelodyMigrations.ALL (the public object MelodyMigrations, covering MIGRATION_1_2 through MIGRATION_16_17, the latest adding index_songs_albumId and index_playback_events_songId) and provides SharedPreferencesLegacyJsonMigration for the first-launch v1 SharedPreferences-JSON-to-Room migration; historical schema JSON must never be edited.

Five DataStore preference files complement Room: player_settings (theme, play modes, Bluetooth/notification toggles, lyric font scale, sleep timer, emotion scan pause, mood-time-slot master switch), playback_state (playback snapshot persistence, owned by :player's PlaybackStateStore with a legacy music_player_prefs SharedPreferences), playlist_resume (per-playlist resume JSON), mood_time_slot (time-slot configs as a single-key JSONArray), and emotion_failures (per-song failure JSON with attempts counting); all are excluded from backup.

Emotion batch scanning is scheduled from MelodyApplication.onCreate via EmotionScanScheduler as a WorkManager unique periodic work (emotion_periodic_scan) every 6 hours under charging + battery-not-low constraints with a 30-minute initial delay and NetworkType.NOT_REQUIRED; the periodic EmotionScanWorker analyzes up to 40 pending songs per run while the manual trigger (manual=true one-time work, unique name emotion_manual_scan) analyzes up to 300 per run and auto-enqueues the next batch with APPEND semantics unless paused, stopped, or an entire batch fails.

EmotionAnalyzer (cn.com.dcsgo.mihx.player, @Singleton) uses FfmpegPcmDecoder (a MediaExtractor + Jellyfin FFmpeg decoder driving the same media3 extension used for playback, chosen after a MediaCodec vendor-soft-decode SIGSEGV on some ROMs) to decode mono s16 PCM, resamples to 16 kHz, then runs per-window YAMNet embedding + emotion_va_head.tflite in :player assets (model version 'yamnet-va-v5-vocal@edbf6fe5', 5s window / 2.5s hop) producing valence/arousal curves and a whole-song vocalScore; both decoder and analyzer share a memory budget derived from maxMemory() to deterministically truncate high-sample-rate tracks instead of OOM, failures carry a displayable EmotionFailureReason, are persisted to EmotionFailureStore, and songs accumulating MAX_ATTEMPTS=3 failures stop being auto-retried.

Analysis results persist in the Room song_emotions table (SongEmotionEntity: valence, arousal, curveJson of raw per-window [v,a,...] floats, peakSec, windowsAnalyzed, durationSec, vocalScore, modelVersion, analyzedAt, plus base64 1024-dim embeddingB64, userValence/userArousal/userTags and userTagsEdited calibration/derivation columns) through SongEmotionsRepository implementing the :domain SongEmotionRepository interface.

Mood time-slot semantics: MoodSlotResolver (:domain, pure logic, independently unit-tested) treats configs as left-closed/right-open [start, end) intervals with end <= start meaning cross-midnight, picks the earliest-starting hit on overlap, and validates saves returning SlotValidation (empty name/name too long/no tags/zero-length/conflict) which TimeSlotConfigStore throws as IllegalArgumentException; PlayerRandomQueueFacade evaluates the active slot per random-play request and filters candidates by emotion-tag match ratio at the planner entry (MoodSlotPolicy.MATCH_MIN_RATIO), falling back to full-library random when the filtered pool is empty and warning when it is below MoodSlotPolicy.POOL_WARN_THRESHOLD=10.

PlayerViewModel is a deliberately thin @HiltViewModel facade delegating to PlayerRuntime, a composition root injected via PlayerRuntimeFactory that lazily assembles graph objects (PlayerQueueGraph, PlayerMediaControllerGraph, PlayerPersistenceGraph, PlayerBluetoothGraph, PlayerPlaybackSessionGraph) and per-concern facades (library, import, playlist, song-deletion, quick-skip, controller-queue, queue, controller-state, playback, media-event, version, random-queue, lifecycle, error, playback-bridge, startup); the old PlayerViewModelComponents assembly hub was deliberately dismantled and verifyProductArchitecture fails the build if any file references it again.

Queue invariants: PlayQueue.songs is the full business queue (duplicates allowed; currentIndex indexes into it) while MediaController only holds a windowed plan whose size stays between 51 and 71 items (20 before + current + 50 after, clipped at queue edges) for 100/500/1000-song libraries as locked by PlaybackWindowPerformanceShapeTest; SongMediaItemMapper sets MediaItem.mediaId to Song.id.toString() as the mapping contract back to the business queue; navigation goes through MediaController, not PlayQueue index arithmetic.

Build variants: debug (no minification, applicationIdSuffix .debug so it coexists with release), release (R8 minify + resource shrink, arm64-v8a only, resConfigs zh/en, falls back to debug signing without keystore.properties unless -PrequireReleaseSigning=true makes the build fail), and benchmark (initWith release but debug-signed, non-debuggable, adds x86_64 for emulators); :benchmark is an Android-test (com.android.test) module targeting :app with StartupBenchmark (cold-start StartupTimingMetric, with and without a baseline profile) and ScrollBenchmark (FrameTimingMetric) run via :benchmark:connectedCheck.

Navigation: AppRoutes defines the Navigation Compose route table (home, playlist, playlist/{id}, artist/{name}, album/{name}, user, settings, lyrics, playback-stats, song-top-list, version-management, emotion-analysis, mood-time-slot, skin-switcher, etc.); the former compile-time AppDestinations enum of three fixed bottom tabs was replaced in the P2 shell rework by an AppShell whose tabs come from the active skin, with AppShell.fromTabRoute/currentDefaultTab reproducing AppDestinations.fromRoute sub-page-to-tab attribution so tab highlight stays correct; app-shell ViewModels including MoodTimeSlotViewModel must be created at Activity scope in AppRoot, because creating them inside NavHost composable blocks falls back to a non-Hilt factory and crashes.

Test tiers: JVM unit tests (./gradlew test, no device) live in domain/, player/, data/, feature/*/, core/* (including core/skin parser/validation) and app/ test sourcesets covering planners, synchronizers, repositories, facades, and skin/shell resolution; instrumented Compose tests (HomeScreenComposeTest, PlaylistScreenComposeTest, SettingsScreenComposeTest, RuntimePermissionPolicyTest) run via :app:connectedAndroidTest on an emulator/device; Macrobenchmarks run via :benchmark:connectedCheck with EMULATOR suppression for x86_64 simulators, though MIUI ROMs may block them.

The Room word-preference feature: a new word_preferences table (WordPreferenceEntity with word PK, likeVotes, dislikeVotes, updatedAt), migrations creating/rewriting it registered in MelodyMigrations.ALL, the :domain WordPreferenceRepository interface (observeAll/getAll/recordSongOutcome/clearAll) backed by :data WordPreferencesRepository, and the WordPreference.kind majority-vote classification (LIKE/DISLIKE/NEUTRAL) in :core:model; votes are counted on song settle via PlayerRuntime.handleExploreSongSettled calling recordSongOutcome with ratio-weighted integer votes (share × 100, ExplorePlaybackPolicy.VOTE_WEIGHT_SCALE). The domain ExplorePlaybackPolicy defines INITIAL_BATCH_SIZE=10, REFILL_COUNT=5, REFILL_THRESHOLD=0, MIN_LISTEN_MS=30000, MIN_LISTEN_RATIO=0.25, VOTE_MIN_RATIO and VOTE_MAX_TAGS, and isSkipped() as the pure completion-vs-skip judgment shared with vote counting.

Explore play (探索播放) is a distinct RandomEnhanceMode (OFF/TIME_SLOT/EXPLORE, mutually exclusive with TIME_SLOT) surfaced on :feature:player via playerSettingsRepository.randomEnhanceMode: PlayerRandomQueueFacade.playRandomQueue (async, onResult callback) generates ExplorePlaybackPolicy.INITIAL_BATCH_SIZE=10 songs and sets isExplorePlay (disabling infinite random), refillExplorePlayQueue adds REFILL_COUNT=5 songs when the just-ended song was second-to-last (REMAINING==REFILL_THRESHOLD=0, measured in PlayerMediaEventFacade.handleMediaItemEnded), and buildExploreRefillPool tiers candidates by liked-and-no-dislike → only-no-dislike → full library using WordPreference.kind; PlayerRuntime observes the mode to set isExploreModeActive and exits the explore session when the mode leaves EXPLORE.

Since v3.12 the word-preference vote scale is ratio-weighted: vote weight = per-word share of the song × 100 (ExplorePlaybackPolicy.VOTE_WEIGHT_SCALE / voteWeightOf), so a skipped/kept track weights its dominant emotion words far more than incidental ones; MIGRATION_15_16 multiplies all historical word_preferences likes/dislikes ×100 to keep old 1-vote-per-word counts on the same scale, and because WordPreference.kind is a relative comparison (likes-vs-dislikes) the rescale does not flip any classification.

MIGRATION_16_17 (the v16→v17 schema step) adds only index_songs_albumId and index_playback_events_songId — the former serving album-directory queries and orphan-album cleanup (which run on every persistence/delete/dedupe/file-validation) and the latter enabling DELETE playback_events WHERE songId IN (...) equality lookups that previously scanned the whole append-only table; exported schema is now data/schemas/17.json.

The emotion model coordinate system is 'yamnet-va-v5-vocal' (EmotionModelSpec.MODEL_VERSION, generated from core/model/emotion_model_spec.properties by :core:model's generateEmotionModelSpec task): arousal is a real RMS loudness envelope mapped through a [-30,-5] dB floor/ceiling window (DB_FLOOR/DB_CEIL), valence is calibrated by V_CAL_BIAS=0.25 and V_CAL_SCALE=0.85, and vocal-compensated anchors shift instrument-dominant (vocalScore <= VOCAL_COMP_THRESHOLD=0.010) tracks' valence up by VOCAL_COMP_SHIFT=0.091 at read time; changing the model fingerprint auto-triggers rescan of rows whose modelVersion mismatches.

EmotionScanWorker pending selection is (analyzed[it.id] != EmotionAnalyzer.MODEL_VERSION || songIdsMissingVocalScore.contains(it.id)) with it.uri != null and attempts < MAX_ATTEMPTS, so both model-version mismatches and rows missing a vocalScore (written before v14) are auto-repicked; manual scans enqueue the next batch with discard only when paused, stopped, or the entire batch failed (to avoid an infinite failure loop), otherwise with APPEND semantics.

PlayerRuntime.playRandomQueue(onResult) and startInfinitePlay(onResult) are async: they launch the suspend facade planner off the main thread (scope=viewModelScope=Main for the callback) and report (started, moodSlotName) via the callback; PlayerViewModel mirrors them with the same onResult signature for election-slot attribution toasts.
